start: Routines tab, member with two or more folders, one of them the followed plan

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Where should the routine go?'
Line 'Your plan only changes if you pick it.'
First row 'My routines' with 'Not in your plan' (and the routine count when the folder exists)
must_not: A routine created before a folder is picked

user_sees: The sheet closes and the routine editor opens with a routine named 'New routine'
must_not: The new routine placed in the followed plan
Two routines made from one tap

steps.action: Go back to the Routines tab
user_sees: 'My routines' is open and shows the new routine; the plan has the same routines as before
must_not: Up next or Today changed by this routine

start: A finished workout opened from the feed or history, its menu open

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Where should the routine go?' with the same rows: My routines first, other folders with their routine counts, the plan last
must_not: A different order of rows than from New routine

steps.action: Tap another folder of the member
user_sees: The sheet closes; the routine is saved into that folder
must_not: The routine saved into the plan

start: Routines tab, two or more folders

steps.action: Tap New routine, then close the sheet with the cross or Back without picking
must_not: A routine called 'New routine' made anyway

steps.action: Tap New routine again and pick My routines while the save fails (phone storage error)
user_sees: A message 'Could not create routine' with 'Please try again.'
must_not: The editor opening on a routine that was never saved

start: Routines tab, member follows a plan named e.g. 'PPL'

user_sees: Last row is the plan name with 'Your plan · Up next will include it' and a tick mark
must_not: The plan row without saying it changes Up next

user_sees: The routine editor opens; back on Routines the plan shows one more routine
must_not: The routine also added to My routines

steps.action: Member whose followed plan is itself an older 'My Routines' taps New routine
user_sees: First row reads 'Other routines' with 'Not in your plan'
must_not: A first row called 'My routines' that is really the followed plan
